comment: Sampling profiles for agent runs (FA-20). The first profile whose pattern (a case-insensitive regular expression) matches the model key is used, so a more specific profile comes first; `--temperature` overrides only the temperature. Every value is sent to LM Studio explicitly. Values are taken from the cited model cards or generation configs; a model without a matching profile gets the fallback.

profiles.source: https://huggingface.co/Qwen/Qwen3-8B (thinking mode; greedy decoding is discouraged); the same values in the cards of Qwen3-0.6B, Qwen3-1.7B and Qwen3-4B-Thinking-2507

fallback.source: not from a model card: temperature 0.7 by decision FA-20, the other values are common llama.cpp defaults
